title: zl.stream
description: list of the last N elements received

messages.description: 1 once N elements were received, 0 before that

arguments.description: number of elements N, negative reverses the list

methods.description: clears the mode's arguments and the data received in both inlets
sets the maximum list size, 1 to 32767

body: [zl.stream] outputs a list of the last N elements it received; a negative N reverses the list. The right outlet sends 1 once N elements were received and 0 before that. A bang resends the last output.
